title: 通过模拟合成：可扩展智能体系统交互生成企业数据
summary: 提出STS范式，让LLM智能体在模拟企业环境中通过策略API生成数据，无需数据库模式即可保证结构有效性与分布保真度，开源框架及十个环境。
summary_en: Introduces Synthesis Through Simulation (STS), a schema-free data synthesis paradigm where an LLM agent generates data by executing operations against policy-enforcing APIs in simulated enterprise environments, guaranteeing structural validity by construction. The Generalist Populator achieves 0.88 average marginal fidelity and 100% constraint satisfaction across ten environments without DB schemas. Framework and datasets are open-sourced.
